excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, Akamai, a cloud service provider supporting and protecting online life, announced a partnership with NVIDIA to launch the new Akamai Inference Cloud, an edge cloud platform specifically designed for AI inference. This means AI model inference and responses will no longer rely on computing power from distant data centers but will be completed closer to users and more quickly. According to Leifeng.com, the Akamai Inference Cloud integrates NVIDIA's latest-generation RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU and BlueField-3 DPU, making it one of the first cloud providers globally to adopt this GPU architecture. The market widely views this card as a significant specification upgrade in the enterprise sector; for instance, Tom’s Hardware notes its VRAM capacity far exceeds that of typical consumer cards, such as the RTX 5090's 32 GB. excerpt_i18n.en: At the Imagine Conference on October 28, NavInfo CEO Cheng Peng announced the rebranding from "NavInfo" (Navigation Information) to "SEEWAY.AI," symbolizing "vision with light and action with dimensions," marking a formal shift from an automotive focus to an AI-driven identity. In his speech, Cheng detailed past motivations and lessons from ventures in chips, ADAS, and mapping. In 2015, he noted that the automotive industry faced unresolved issues, such as core technologies like chips and ADAS being monopolized by a few international giants. He stated that NavInfo aimed to challenge whether Chinese companies could develop their own automotive chips, create domestic ADAS, and provide smart cockpit solutions. Over the past decade, NavInfo has established major business segments: Smart Cloud, Smart Chip, Smart Cockpit, and Smart Driving, with Smart Driving driving integration across all products. For example, its chip business—AC8015/8025—supports hardware compatibility with certifications from 168 countries. During the 2021 chip shortage, many automaker CEOs visited Cheng's office seeking chips. Financial reports show the chip business remains a crucial pillar for NavInfo, with gross margins second only to Smart Driving. Currently, NavInfo's revenue is split 30-70, with cloud, mapping, and positioning at 70%, but in three years, it will reverse, with AI-based orders and projects at 70% and traditional business at 30%.
excerpt_i18n.es: En la actualidad, los ingresos de NavInfo se dividen en una proporción de tres a siete: nube, mapas y posicionamiento representan el setenta por ciento, pero dentro de tres años se invertirá esta proporción. Los pedidos y puntos fijos que manejo, basados en negocios de IA, serán el setenta por ciento, mientras que los negocios tradicionales serán el treinta por ciento. El 28 de octubre, en la Conferencia de Innovación, el CEO de NavInfo, Cheng Peng, anunció la actualización de la marca de "NavInfo" (información de navegación) a "SEEWAY.AI", simbolizando "tener luz en los ojos y dimensiones en la acción", marcando oficialmente la transición de "persona automotriz" a "persona de IA". En su discurso, Cheng Peng detalló las motivaciones y experiencias pasadas en la exploración de negocios como chips, conducción asistida y mapas desde 2015.

excerpt_i18n.en: On November 4, the highly anticipated AI model real-time investment competition "Alpha Arena" concluded, with Alibaba's Qwen emerging as the ultimate champion. items.raw_excerpt: 现在的 AI 生成技术突飞猛进，但视频创作仍然是一件“高门槛”的事。 虽然生成式 AI 带来了前所未有的创作能力，但整个流程仍然琐碎。创作者需要先写脚本，再用文生视频工具生成画面，随后还要处理配音、剪辑、字幕、节奏……每一步都依赖不同的软件。专业团队可以用流程去衔接这些环节，但对普通创作者来说，这样的分工往往意味着更多的时间成本和学习负担。 AI 让创作更容易开始，却还没有让创作变得更连贯。真正的突破，也许不是更大的模型或更强的算力，而是让 AI 真正理解创意、参与创作。只有当这些分散的环节被重新连起来，创意才能自然流动。 未来的 AI 视频创作，或许不在于增加更多工具，而是在于形成一个统一的系统——让文字、图像和声音能在同一个空间协作，让构思、生成和调整在同一语境中完成。 而现在，这种改变，正在被昆仑万维逐步实现。 全新 SkyReels：创作不再有缝隙 昆仑万维最新推出的全新 SkyReels，就是在这种“重构创作方式”的思路下诞生的。它不是又一款单一的生成工具，而是一套让创作重新回到“统一与流动”的多模态系统。 在全新 SkyReels 里，图片、视频、音乐和人声讲解等元素都被放在同一个空间中理解和生成。创作者不用再在不同平台之间来回切换、反复导入导出，而是能在同一张画布上完成构思、生成和调整。创作的过程因此变得更顺畅，创意也能自然地延伸下去。 为了让更多人进入这种新的创作方式，全新 SkyReels 还设计了 3 种方式： 它既可以让熟悉 AI 的创作者可以直接生成图像、视频、音频或数字人，也能帮助希望获得更结构化帮助的用户，可以调用近三十个聚焦具体场景的 Agent，获得任务级协助。除此之外，初学者或效率导向的创作者，只需使用模板，输入文字或替换画面，即可快速完成创作。 而这一切，都发生在一张无限画布上。画布让不同模态的内容以拖拽的方式被组织与组合，让创意的边界随

excerpt_i18n.en: AI generation technology is advancing rapidly, but video creation remains a high-barrier task. While generative AI offers unprecedented creative capabilities, the overall process is still fragmented. Creators must first write scripts, then use text-to-video tools to generate visuals, followed by handling voiceovers, editing, subtitles, pacing—each step relying on different software. Professional teams can streamline these stages with workflows, but for average creators, such division often means more time investment and learning burdens. AI makes starting creation easier but hasn't made it more seamless. The real breakthrough may not be larger models or greater computing power, but enabling AI to truly understand creativity and participate in creation. Only when these scattered steps are reconnected can creativity flow naturally. The future of AI video creation may not lie in adding more tools but in forming a unified system—where text, images, and sound collaborate in one space, and ideation, generation, and refinement happen in the same context. Now, Kunlun Tech is gradually realizing this change. Introducing SkyReels: Seamless Creation. Kunlun Tech's latest SkyReels is born from this vision of redefining creation. It's not just another standalone generation tool but a multimodal system that restores creation to "unity and flow." In SkyReels, elements like images, videos, music, and voice narration are all integrated.
